title: Analysis code: Clinical presentation and recorded follow-up findings of thyroid eye disease in Colombian referral centers
description: R code that derives all variables from the Colombian multicenter thyroid eye disease (TED) registry and reproduces every number, table and figure of the article "Clinical Presentation and Recorded Follow-up Findings of Thyroid Eye Disease in Colombian Referral Centers: A Multicenter Retrospective Registry Study" (Therapeutic Advances in Ophthalmology). The patient-level registry data are not included; a synthetic data set with the same structure is provided so that the code can be run end to end. The code runs on any data set built with the same registry template.
